name: Gust Sprite
notes: DRAFT for C13-3 (bestiary-plan.md). Spins and blows you sideways. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (R-BAL-8). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
tell: spins, then a pale gust arrow
senseiLine: The wind only pushes. Stay steady.

lore.brown-black: A playful breeze that spun too fast. Calm it, and it blows a cool, gentle wind.

bestiary.insight: Advanced: ride the gust to slip away from a crowd.

push.note: No-damage push (Manager OK, C13). Never into a hazard or off a ledge.
